copy.tagline: 自动生成新员工入职流程与任务清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责新员工入职安排，想自动化首周日程和任务分配。
copy.tagline_en: Automate new employee onboarding tasks and schedules
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage employee onboarding and want to automate first-week tasks.

howto.what: 让 Claude 生成一张新员工入职单页:欢迎区(姓名、入职日、团队)、5 天首周日程、经理与 buddy 卡片、学习清单、设备清单,以及“你设置好了当且仅当…”标准区。
howto.when: 当你要做新员工入职资料或首周日程,或提到“入职”“first week”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我给下周入职的新同事做一张首周入职单页
say.note: 产出含 5 天日程与 buddy 卡片

say.text: 在入职页里加上设备清单和“设置完成”标准
把学习路径换成我们团队实际在用的工具列表
say.note: 改写 Learning track 列表内容

howto.what_en: Claude produces a one-page onboarding doc for a new hire: welcome hero (name, start date, team), a 5-day first-week schedule, manager and buddy cards, a learning track list, an equipment checklist, and 'set up if and only if' outcomes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for new-hire onboarding material or a first-week schedule, or mention 'onboarding' / 'first week'.

say_en.text: Build a first-week onboarding page for the new hire starting Monday.
say_en.note: Includes a 5-day schedule and buddy card.

say_en.text: Add the equipment checklist and 'set up if and only if' section to it.
Swap the learning track for the tools our team actually uses.
